Internal helper: the assignment lines of an assign-or-lose reminder

Source: R/utils.R
dot-jst_assign_lines.Rd

The code lines under the reminders of jrecode(), jencode(), jsum() and javg(), each of which returns a new variable's values and changes nothing. A name or a place gets the one pattern line it always had. An expression gets two: it is assigned to mydata, and the pattern line is written on mydata, because mk()$<name> <- jsum(...) is not R (Session 343).

Usage

.jst_assign_lines(fn_name, data_name, data_kind, typed)

Arguments

fn_name

Character(1); the function the lines call.

data_name

Character(1); the data frame as the line names it.

data_kind

What the call gave as its data, as .jst_data_arg_kind() reads it.

typed

Character(1); the data argument as typed.

Value

Character(1): one line or two, each ending in a newline.
